readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, at the start of the dinner, when Aurèle had each guest show his watch
When Dr Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case, by his own watch ("until a quarter to eleven by my watch")
The temple struck ten while the card game was still going on
When Dr Vauthier looked at the salon clock after the temple struck ten ("five minutes to ten")

durations: Thirty years (Dr Vauthier has been at the Monniers' house as the family's physician and friend)
Two minutes (Dr Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the temple bell, as Aurèle told him)
whereabouts: Dr Vauthier was at the Monniers' house tonight, having been asked to dine.
Dr Vauthier was present at the dinner when Aurèle had each guest show his watches at nine.
Dr Vauthier and Madame (Odile) played piquet in the salon after dinner.
Dr Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat at a quarter to eleven.
Dr Vauthier came back from the hall to the salon.
Madame began to play the piano as Dr Vauthier went out to the hall.
Madame stopped playing the piano when Dr Vauthier came back.
Dr Vauthier and Madame were still at cards when the temple struck ten.
Dr Vauthier looked at the salon clock while in the salon at about ten.
Dr Vauthier has seen the body of Monsieur Monnier.
